concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Retain concept shield, anchor and low matrix; reject photoreal grain and excessive broad high mound. A single continuous closed matrix heightfield integrates shield and raised T relief; no stacked coplanar animal shell. Broad rounded transverse end with tapering opposite end. Anchor stem subordinate to shield. Minor fine ridges omitted because their external status is disputed; no unsupported appendages.
